services.name: Lanigan & Disctrict Curling Rink
services.desc: The Lanigan & District Curling Rink is a hub of community activities, offering a welcoming and well-equipped facility for curlers of all ages and all levels. With four sheets of artificial ice and a warm atmosphere created by its free span roofing supported by metal beams, the rink provides an ideal environment for enjoying this classic winter sport. Spacious Layout: Ample walkways at both ends of the ice provide curlers with plenty of space to move and prepare for your games. Unrestricted Viewing: Spectators can enjoy unrestricted views of the action from two levels. The upper level features glassing that offers excellent visibility from any position, while the lower level is fully glassed

services.name: Lanigan Golf Course Campground
services.desc: The Lanigan Golf Course Campground offers a perfect retreat for you, located conveniently beside the Lanigan Golf Course and close to the waterpark. With thirty-three well-treed lots, you can enjoy a serene environment with plenty of amenities. With its close proximity to the waterpark, you can easily enjoy a day of fun and relaxation. Whether you’re here for the golfing, the waterpark, or simply to enjoy the great outdoors, our campground provides a comfortable and convenient base for your stay. Lanigan is located on the traditional lands of the Treaty 4 Territory, a Treaty signed with 36 First Nations across Southern Saskatchewan and parts of Alberta and Manitoba, and the original lands
